question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        AVG(ov.review_score) as avg_review_score,
        AVG((CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) as avg_packing_time
    FROM order_items oi
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews ov ON oi.order_id = ov.order_id
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        ptc.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation ptc ON p.product_category_name = ptc.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, ptc.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity,
    sm.total_sales,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    sm.avg_review_score,
    sm.avg_packing_time,
    tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english,
    tc.category_sales as top_category_sales
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN top_categories tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id
WHERE tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY tc.category_sales DESC
